ev.q: In 2023, reports of imported malaria in three U.S. southern border jurisdictions increased from cases reported in 2022.
Severe malaria was more common among other newly arrived migrants (18 of 49; 37%) than among U.S. residents (one of 15; 7%).
Overall, 63 (91%) patients with malaria were hospitalized; no deaths were reported.
